text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed the Python snippet in the Console -> Tracing quickstart doesn't pass trace context into the SDK example. It causes dashboards to show orphaned spans.

alex: ugh thanks for catching. Which snippet file?

maria: docs/observability/tracing/quickstart_python.md (line ~45 in preview). The example uses `client.send_event("start")` but never wraps with `with tracer.start_span(...)` or forwards `trace_id`.

kevin: I ran the snippet locally — same. CI's lint passed but e2e on local showed separate traces.

sophie: Proposed fix: replace the minimal call with a tiny context example so it's still short but correct. e.g.:
```python
from redwood import Tracer
tracer = Tracer()
with tracer.start_span("handle_request") as span:
    tracer.send_event("start", span=span)
```
that should reconnect the span to the dashboard timeline.

maria: yes that's perfect. Also rename the dashboard panel id from `cost_panel_v1` to `token_cost_v2` to match the new metrics mapping — otherwise the snippet references the wrong panel slug.

alex: I opened a small PR #4123 with the snippet + panel rename. CI failing on the docs linkcheck stage because one internal link points to `guides/old-trace-hook` (404).

kevin: I can update redirects in the site config, but can we instead change the md to point to `guides/tracehook-migration`? less churn for infra.

maria: yep change the link in the PR. Also add a one-sentence note about why we prefer context-managed spans (kv cache interplay, faster aggregation for cost attribution).

sophie: quick review requested @kevin @alex — if you can approve I'll squash and merge. I also asked docs-bot to run the preview build. :pray:

docs-bot: preview build triggered for PR #4123 — https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/4123 (rendered pages: 3)

kevin: LGTM for the link change and panel rename. small nit: prefer `tracer.start_span(name="handle_request")` to be explicit. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

alex: approved. I'll monitor logs after merge for any orphan spans alerts.

maria: merging now. Post-merge checklist: run synthetic that sends 100 sample traces and ensure the cost/latency breakdown dashboard shows grouped traces. I'll post results.

maria: post-merge result: synthetic run showed traces grouped, cost panel updated, no new 404s from linkcheck. Closing follow-up in staging. :tada:
